name: Suzhou Tianmai Thermal Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Tianmai Thermal Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sales of thermal management materials and devices in China and internationally. The company offers thermal pads, including conventional and multi-functional thermal conductive pads; phase change, no silicon, and silicon thermal conductive greases; and plastic thermal conductive adhesives. It also provides thermal conductive gels and pastes; nano carbon copper piece and graphite thermal diffusion sheets; thermal insulation sheets; heat spreader and pipes; thermal interface materials; and vapor chambers.
